what: The GPU code of study 5's order repeat under AdamW (docs/study5-adamw-registration.md): the identity of its GPU paths at the commit named.
engineering_check: The AdamW Pod reruns pod 2's order control of seed 50000 at η_l under this code before any A run and compares it under extension 2's numerical equivalence (scripts/study5_dose_campaigns.py adamw, block engineering); a failure stops the Pod. The paths changed since the dose experiment's record add the order_a role (arm A in a new order), its config and the seeds module, and list the repeat's analysis outside the GPU code; an F or dose run is unchanged. A later GPU change needs a new check and a new record.
